title: Commercial Fencing Accounts: Align HubSpot Site Contacts With Acumatica Customer and Project Records
summary: Connect fencing sales contacts to the right site, customer and project without confusing access with purchasing authority.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Commercial fencing companies should align HubSpot contacts and opportunities with Acumatica customer and project records using explicit roles and stable references. Site access, property ownership, purchasing authority and invoice delivery may belong to different people. Sales owns relationship context, project coordination owns site details, and finance owns billing identity. Two-way sync can keep approved changes visible while preserving the authority required for scope and financial decisions.


Explore the complete[fencing fabrication and installation integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/fencing-fabrication-installation) for the systems and processes around this guide.
